verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Oneleet supports a customizable, publishable Trust Center linked from a landing page, which is the core hosted trust-center capability sales teams use to pre-empt security reviews. However, no evidence describes live control-status display, certification badges, or report sharing under click-through NDA — key elements of the story. missing for 10: live control status display, certifications listing, click-through NDA-gated report sharing, independent/hands-on corroboration.
